Summary
: This essay studies the Jivanandana (in English) which is a dramatic play (Nataka) written by Anadaraya Makhin in the 18th century. The Jiva-nandana praises the excellence of Advaita Vedanta, Ayurveda (medical science) and Dramatic literature as the triple agency for obtaining everlasting bliss.
